notes:
### Expiry-Aware Dorcel Handoff

- Dorcel now reads the active signed HLS `e=` expiry directly instead of relying on an estimated session-age timer. The expiry path arms within the last six minutes of the current session.
- Within the last five minutes, the next real visible stall may perform one prepared PVR_COM / PVR_COM_SITE handoff. If no suitable stall occurs, a controlled fallback handoff is allowed during the final 60 seconds before expiry.

### Standby / Provider-Outage Separation

- The background standby is revalidated before an expiry handoff and must be mature with enough remaining token lifetime to be useful.
- Shared/provider HTTP 404 outages keep the v1.154 natural recovery path and do not trigger the preventive expiry switch. Normal SOURCE_WINDOW stalls outside the expiry window still never cause a planned restart.

### Dialog / Route Safety

- An open One Channel extension dialog blocks the preventive expiry switch until the dialog is closed, avoiding another v1.153-style dialog interruption.
- Replacement playback continues through PVR_COM / PVR_COM_SITE with the existing timeline protections. No direct child-HLS player and no local HLS proxy/fallback are introduced.

### Important

- Dorcel's old planned hourly/token handoff remains disabled. Live delay, Unlimited handling, log saving, shutdown behavior and the existing website-down recovery remain unchanged.
